S: Lifts land 12% deeper, pinning attackers to the back line.
SS: After blocking a hard smash (180+ km/h), your shots are 14% faster for 2 seconds. Cooldown 8 s.
U: All of Chen Long's lifts go to the very back of the court and are always in. After a lift, Chen Long goes into a defensive stance: his reach is 25% bigger for the next shot. His blocks are much less likely to fail to get over the net.

S: Net shots get a 12% wider perfect-timing window.
SS: Crosscourt drops have a 15% chance of wrong-footing the opponent. Cooldown 5 s.
U: After 3 net shots in a row, Kento Momota's next net shot always tumbles, and he never touches the net on net kills. He can net kill and net tap tighter net shots than his opponents can.

S: After a retrieval, 10% faster movement for 3 seconds. Cooldown 8 s.
SS: A perfectly timed smash is up to 12% faster (within the game’s smash limit). Cooldown 6 s.
U: After a successful smash, Lee Chong Wei moves 40% faster, so he can reach tight blocks close to the net. After a successful net shot, he moves 50% faster getting back to the back court.

SS: A crosscourt smash or drive has a 14% chance of wrong-footing the opponent. Cooldown 5 s.
U: Every attacking shot Lin Dan plays in a row (drives, smashes, drops, net kills, net taps) boosts his power, accuracy and speed by 7.5%. The boost resets when he has to play a defensive or neutral shot (lifts, clears, net shots).

SS: After a clear, the opponent moves 14% slower for 1.2 seconds. Cooldown 8 s.
U: Shots on Taufik Hidayat's backhand side have 30% more power and are 50% more accurate. He can play backhand smashes, at 85% of his forehand smash power.

S: Smashes are up to 8% faster (within the game’s smash limit). Cooldown 6 s.
SS: After winning a point at the net, the next attacking shot is 15% faster. Cooldown 10 s.
U: Smashes have 20% more power and need perfect timing to defend, by block or lift. A defence without perfect timing leaves the opponent stunned for 1 second, unable to move. A mistimed defence goes to half court or high at the net 90% of the time.
